eyebrow: Microsoft Azure Administration, Compute & Storage · Chapter 4
subtitle: Lesson 13 · Azure Storage

code:
az storage account create \
  --name ltvstorage01 \
  --resource-group rg-storage-lab \
  --location eastus \
  --sku Standard_LRS \
  --kind StorageV2
caption: Blob, file, queue, and table storage all live inside this one account.

steps.label: Standard (HDD)
steps.sub: lower cost, the default for backups and bulk unstructured data

steps.label: Premium (SSD)
steps.sub: low, consistent latency for VM disks and latency-sensitive workloads

steps.label: StorageV2 kind
steps.sub: general-purpose v2 — blob, file, queue, table on either tier

code:
az storage account show \
  --name ltvstorage01 \
  --resource-group rg-storage-lab \
  --query "{sku:sku.name, kind:kind}" \
  -o table
caption: Confirms the SKU (Standard_LRS) and kind (StorageV2) you just provisioned.
